item.title: NocoBase Workflow Script Node vm Sandbox Escape to Root RCE (CVE-2026-34156)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9.9) — web · CVE-2026-34156. Status: PoC (the sandbox escape payload is genuine and complete, but the node-test delivery path is unverified, success detection is weak and no successful run is documented). Affects: NocoBase, an AI-powered no-code/low-code platform, specifically the workflow engine Script Node and its Node.js vm sandbox. Tags: nocobase, nodejs, vm-sandbox-escape, workflow, script-node, authenticated, rce, cwe-913, prototype-chain, container-root.
